data.name: Muflihi
data.gender_notes: Muflihi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'afalah' meaning 'to save'. Muflihi is a name given to a boy who is believed to be saved from calamities and troubles in his life. In the Quran, Allah says, 'Allah will deliver him from his distress and is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.' (9:40). The name Muflihi carries the meaning “Saved, Secured, Protected” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muflihi usually hope their child will grow to embody saved, secured, protected and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes divine protection and salvation.
data.etymology: Muflihi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Saved, Secured, Protected.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muflihi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
